measurement.name: Caribbean Current
measurement.range_interpretation: One reported October value. Separate historical range has unresolved upper units; no numerical range, confidence interval or annual extrema admitted.
measurement.geographic_scope: Southern Caribbean mainstream on the Puerto Rico-Venezuela meridian, 67 W.
measurement.section_orientation: Meridional section; no perpendicular-to-axis correction reproduced.
measurement.layer: Geostrophic sea-surface current relative to 1600 dbar. No fixed numerical width layer.
measurement.time_convention: October 1974 author-reported section description. Exact observation day unknown; not a climatology or an annual maximum.
measurement.boundary_rule: Southern limit selected geographically at Los Roques, 12 N. Northern edge method not independently reproduced; no paired velocity-boundary coordinates extracted.
measurement.source_citation: Duncan, Schladow and Williams (1982), Surface Currents Near the Greater and Lesser Antilles, International Hydrographic Review 59(2), 67-78. Archive upload 2015.
measurement.source_locator: Printed p77 / PDF p11, mainstream width bullet; p76 / PDF p10 methods and Figure 10 caption.
measurement.extraction_method: Explicit kilometre value transcribed from visually inspected original prose; no figure boundary digitization.
measurement.source_quality_note: Original paper inspected. Coarse station sampling and geographic southern boundary limit interpretation. Underlying 1976 section study and raw stations not independently reproduced; mixed range units unresolved.
remaining_gates: Recover original section stations and paired velocity-edge rule.
Resolve the historical upper-endpoint mile unit.
Obtain compatible repeats before annual margins; independent scientific review.

original_regional_context.display_aria_label: Caribbean Current: approximately 410 km reported mainstream span at 67 W in October 1974. Southern limit fixed at Los Roques; paired velocity boundaries unresolved. No annual range or uncertainty supplied.
original_regional_context.display_caption: October 1974 at 67 W: approximately 410 km author-reported mainstream span, with associated surface-geostrophic speed 0.66 m/s. Reference pressure 1600 dbar is not a depth slab. Numerical uncertainty and annual range unknown.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Southern limit fixed at Los Roques, 12 N; typical stations 60 nautical miles apart. The separate historical 108 nautical miles to 225 miles range retains an unresolved upper unit. No mapped edges or seasonal animation inferred.
